newsitem.title: GERMANY: VIAG says SKW Trostberg 96 sales unchanged.
newsitem.headline: VIAG says SKW Trostberg 96 sales unchanged.

text.p: German diversified industrial group Viag AG said on Friday that its majority owned specialty chemicals unit SKW Trostberg showed a slightly higher 1996 profit while sales were largely steady.
SKW Trostberg, which listed its shares on the bourse in 1995, posted sales of 3.873 billion marks in 1996, compared with 3.875 billion marks a year earlier.
Viag said that sales lost through disinvestments in SKW's natural foodstuffs business was compensated by higher construction chemicals sales.
Viag did not give SKW's 1996 operating profit. In 1995 operating profit stood at 280 million marks.
Viag's activities span power generation, the manufacture of packaging and chemicals, distribution and logistics, and telecommunications.
For the company as a whole the 1996, operating profit before tax rose to just under 2.4 billion marks from 2.1 billion marks according to provisional figures, Viag said in a statement.
Group sales rose to about 42.5 billion marks from 41.9 billion marks, Viag added.
